lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments observed. Spacing is relatively equidistant across the mid-torso (approx. 25-35 pixels) and narrows slightly as lines approach the anterior shoulder.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 5th vertical line from the posterior edge, with a Y-shaped split occurring in the upper dorsal quadrant.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The two anterior-most vertical lines are truncated, terminating at the mid-torso level and failing to reach the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 4 distinct circular white spots located on the posterior haunch above the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the upper lateral thigh show a horizontal geometric alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking across the lower snout; two distinct white spots on the lower cheek; white transverse banding on the forelimbs above the hooves.
